name: Arcane Defense
body:
Choose a school of magic. You can resist spells from that school better than normal.

Benefit: Add a +2 bonus to saving throws you make against spells of the chosen school.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you take the feat, it applies to a new school of magic.
